scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @wlfv/server" "npm run dev -w @wlfv/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wlfv/shared && npm run build -w @wlfv/server && npm run build -w @wlfv/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wlfv/shared && npm run typecheck -w @wlfv/server && npm run typecheck -w @wlfv/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wlfv/server && npm run test -w @wlfv/web
